title: Stock Market Highlights, Oct 15: Sensex jumps over 1,500 points, Nifty nears 23,000; rupee extends gains - The HinduBusinessLine
text:

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights: Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 15th October 2026.

Indian equity benchmarks rallied on Thursday, with the Sensex surging 1,533.72 points, or 2.11 per cent, to 74,315.61 and the Nifty 50 gaining 374.65 points, or 1.66 per cent, to 22,997.35. The gains came despite heavy selling across Asian markets amid concerns over stretched artificial intelligence valuations and higher US inflation.

Analysts said the global technology sell-off improved India’s relative appeal, while falling bond yields, a stable rupee and lower crude oil prices supported sentiment. Nifty IT, Private Bank and Auto led sectoral gains, while Media and PSU Bank declined. IDBI Bank plunged 8 per cent after the Cabinet approved a ₹52,878-crore stake sale to Fairfax at a discount.

The rupee rose 12 paise to 95.05 against the US dollar, marking its fifth consecutive session of gains. Brent crude fell over 2 per cent, while gold and silver prices advanced. Analysts flagged earnings and foreign investor flows as key factors for market direction.

Follow our Q2 results live here and stay tuned to businessline for more updates

* Sensex: Rose 1,533.72 points, or 2.11 per cent, to close at 74,315.61.

* Nifty 50: Gained 374.65 points, or 1.66 per cent, to 22,997.35.

* Sectoral leaders: Nifty Private Bank advanced 1.89 per cent, Nifty IT rose 1.82 per cent and Nifty Auto gained 1.67 per cent.

* Sectoral laggards: Nifty PSU Bank fell 1.55 per cent, while Nifty Media declined 1.47 per cent.

* IDBI Bank: Shares plunged 8 per cent to ₹83.07 after Cabinet approval for a ₹52,878-crore stake sale to Fairfax at a discount.

* Rupee: Appreciated 12 paise to close at 95.05 against the US dollar, marking its fifth consecutive session of gains.

* Crude oil: Brent fell more than 2 per cent to $103.55 a barrel.

* Gold: Rose more than 1.3 per cent to ₹1,47,804 per 10 grams.

* Silver: Gained 1.32 per cent to ₹2,11,083.

* Asian markets: Japan’s Nikkei fell more than 5 per cent, South Korea’s KOSPI plunged over 8 per cent, Taiwan’s weighted index dropped 3.53 per cent and Hong Kong’s Hang Seng declined 1.15 per cent.

* Nifty levels: Near-term support at 22,950–22,900, followed by 22,750; resistance at 23,050–23,150.

* Sensex levels: Support at 74,100–73,900; resistance at 74,600–74,900.

EarlySalary Services Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Social Worth Technologies Limited (“SWTL”) and the NBFC arm of Fibe, has received improved credit rating assessments from India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) and CRISIL Ratings. India Ratings has upgraded the rating on the company’s non-convertible debentures to ‘IND A’/Stable from ‘IND A-Positive’.
